product_one_liner.value: Incorta provides enterprise data and AI teams with a governed platform connecting live business-system data to analytics, AI agents, applications, and workflows.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans and prices appear on Incorta’s Microsoft Marketplace listing, rather than a standalone pricing page on incorta.com.

employee_band.notes: The available company-profile information reports 328 LinkedIn-associated employees and a 201–500 company-size band.

founded_year.notes: Tracxn lists 2013, and Incorta’s company history begins with prototypes in 2013. An older funding announcement instead says 2014.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering@Incorta includes engineer-authored posts explaining its in-memory join/index architecture and OpenCopilot’s agent implementation.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes guides, concepts, tools, and references covering installation, administration, security, connectors, and product functionality.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The verified job board lists engineering and sales openings, but none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. AI-related responsibilities in generic software-engineering roles do not qualify under the requested rule.

model_provider.notes: Its engineering posting explicitly names Anthropic and OpenAI LLM APIs in the product’s data plane.

compliance_certs.notes: Incorta states that its SOC 2 Type II report is available on request and claims GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn records an undisclosed SVB debt round on June 24, 2021. The latest publicly announced equity round was a $120 million Series D on June 23, 2021, which other funding profiles identify as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified equity and debt financing dates are in June 2021, before the requested window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive opening covers the Mid West territory.

launched_6mo.notes: Incorta announced Analyst Studio on September 30, 2026, introducing governed data transformation and an AI Workflow Assistant. General availability was expected in November 2026; this answer counts the dated feature announcement.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Omar Hajsaleh’s profile dates his start as Incorta Vice President of Sales EMEA to December 2025, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Named as CRM and marketing-automation experience in a marketing job posting; these are hiring signals, not confirmation that every system is deployed internally.
